item.title: Recognition, Craft, and a Quietly Growing Studio - AI Global Media
item.description: Pavlina Campell is the woman at the helm of Pinterior Space, having both founded the studio and served as its creative director since the beginning. The more than 20 years of experience she brings to her business has positioned it as one of England’s leading design studios, and it today works with residential clients right across the South East of England.

item.title: A Powerful Partnership and a Global Audience: The Taniere Success Story - AI Global Media
item.description: Taniere is a leading bakery based in Yongin, South Korea, renowned for its delectable selection of pastries and baked goods. The bakery creates healthy products and exceptional tastes without artificial improver, instead baking breads, pastries, sweets, and cakes with levain and slow fermentation processes. This mission is led by Joonho, rising entrepreneur and Owner of Taniere.
